statement.zh: Majumdar《Explorations in Sind》(ASI Memoir 48, 1934) 报告 1927–31 年信德探查调查，并识别后来称为阿姆里类型的材料。
statement.en: Majumdar’s Explorations in Sind (ASI Memoir 48, 1934) reports the 1927–31 exploratory survey and recognizes material later labeled Amri-type.
